vulnerabilities.title: Ignored Error
vulnerabilities.description: Error return from database.Connect is discarded with blank identifier
vulnerabilities.snippet:
var version string
	db,_ := database.Connect()
vulnerabilities.remediation: Always handle errors. At minimum, log the error.

vulnerabilities.title: Potentially Missing Authentication
vulnerabilities.description: HTTP handler 'settingViewHandler' handles sensitive operations without visible authentication checks
vulnerabilities.snippet:
func settingViewHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, _ httprouter.Params){
	data := make(map[string]interface{})

	data["title"] = "Setting & system info"
	data["dbversion"] = getDBMSVersion()
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add authentication middleware or explicit auth checks for sensitive handlers.

vulnerabilities.title: Weak Cryptographic Algorithm
vulnerabilities.description: MD5 is cryptographically broken and should not be used for security purposes (import: crypto/md5)
vulnerabilities.snippet:
"net/http"
	"crypto/md5"
	"encoding/hex"
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use SHA-256/SHA-512 for hashing, AES-GCM for encryption. For passwords, use bcrypt/scrypt/argon2.

vulnerabilities.description: Secret/token compared using == which is vulnerable to timing attacks
vulnerabilities.snippet:
res := &DataResponse{}

vulnerabilities.remediation: Use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare() from crypto/subtle for comparing secrets, tokens, and passwords.

vulnerabilities.title: Unchecked Type Assertion
vulnerabilities.description: Single-value type assertion will panic if the type does not match
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use two-value type assertion: val, ok := x.(Type); if !ok { handle error }

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.description: SQL query built using string concatenation or user input: "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS " + config.Dbname
vulnerabilities.snippet:
}
	_, err = db.Exec("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS " + config.Dbname)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries with placeholders ($1, ?, @param). Example: db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1", id)

vulnerabilities.title: Resource Leak - Database Connection Not Closed
vulnerabilities.description: Database connection opened but no defer db.Close() found
vulnerabilities.snippet:
dsn = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s@tcp(%s:%s)/", config.User, config.Password, config.Sqlhost, config.Sqlport)
	db, err := sql.Open("mysql", dsn)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Ensure database connections are closed.
